integrity_notes: The proof is self-contained apart from standard Beatty complementarity, continued-fraction facts and elementary irrational-rotation equidistribution, each explained in the result. There has been no independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns mixed lower/upper golden-ratio Wythoff representations of positive integers, not arbitrary complementary Beatty sequences.
The logarithmic pointwise discrepancy bound is not claimed optimal.
The convergence rate is for Lipschitz test functions; no uniform distribution-function approximation at the limiting atom is asserted.
A highly relevant earlier paper with DOI 10.1007/s10998-020-00343-0 was identifiable but not available for full-text comparison; historical priority requires further review.
Finite computational checks do not independently certify the infinite proof.
title: An atomic-continuous limiting law for mixed Wythoff representation counts
